title: Gemma 4: Google's Multimodal Open Model Family
summary: Gemma 4 is a series of natively multimodal open models ranging from 2B to 31B parameters, optimized for on-device execution and high-throughput agentic workflows. It features a toggleable thinking mode for complex reasoning and is released under a fully open Apache 2.0 license.
research_notes: Introduced 'Thinking' mode for internal Chain-of-Thought and native support for text, image, video, and audio inputs across all model sizes.

evolution.summary: Released on April 2, 2026, marking a shift to Apache 2.0 licensing. In May 2026, Google added Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) drafter models for all sizes, achieving 3x faster inference. The family is now integrated natively into Android AICore for system-level privacy-first features.
